title: Rattata’s Teeth Can Turn Dinner Into a Death Sentence
premise: Rattata’s ever-growing incisors force it to gnaw hard objects, or they can grow too long for it to eat.
audiencePromise: See why Rattata chewing furniture is not mischief, but a fight against its own teeth.
openLoop: Why can chewing a table leg be the difference between food and starvation?
payoff: Rattata gnaws to wear down its lifelong tooth growth. If its incisors win, it cannot eat and starves.
engagementQuestion: Would you offer a file or protect your furniture?

voice.instructions: Start with sharp danger and a brief pause after the hook. Build pressure as the tooth meter rises. Make the furniture reveal playful, then deliver the starvation reveal plainly and seriously.
